title: Held native Doppler from fixed early orbit hypotheses
sample: Five measured recordings at one roof and two within-lane late derangements. The fifth recording was hash-selected after fixing the roster rule.
boundary: Capture clock and early GLRT determine all orbit and RF hypotheses. Later votes use the original scheduled receiver/RF opportunities and match against two frequency placebos.
note: Given-survey points are separately privileged diagnostics. They contribute no blind predictions. Offers enter evaluation only.
